item.title: Explosion Under Santa Clarita Pizzeria Shuts Down Surrounding Area
item.description: A Santa Clarita pizzeria was evacuated Sunday after several explosions occurred beneath the restaurant. item.title: Six People Displaced By Residential Fire in Perris
item.description: Firefighters Sunday were battling a fire that displaced six people from a two-story residence in Perris. The fire was reported around 2:50 p.m. Sunday in the 700 block of Celebration Lane, according to the Riverside County Fire Department. item.description: Firefighters knocked down a fire at a vacant two-story government housing building in Los Angeles in less than 20 minutes Sunday, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department. item.title: Torrance Intersection to Close Due to Traffic Signal Installation
item.description: Intermittent lane closures were planned to occur in all directions near an intersection in Torrance due to a traffic signal installation Monday. The closures will occur between 9 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. Monday near the intersection of Lomita Boulevard and Madison Street, according to Torrance Public Works. Motorists were advised to avoid the area.

item.title: Ocean Earthquake Shakes the South Bay
item.description: A 3.5-magnitude earthquake rattled the ocean off of the South Bay area Sunday evening.
